biggest_catch: Bonus offer code must be used when opening — this is the public offer page, but you must open 'from this offer webpage' with the code; a bonus received for any Wells Fargo consumer checking account in the past 12 months disqualifies you.
catches: Offer ends October 13, 2026 — must open by that date.
New consumer checking customers only; excludes anyone who received a Wells Fargo consumer checking bonus in the past 12 months, Wells Fargo employees, and non-resident aliens.
Bonus offer code must be used when opening the account from the offer webpage.
10 or more qualifying POSTED transactions within 60 days — pending transactions and ATM/teller transactions do not count; timing of posting can vary from same day to weeks.
$25 minimum opening deposit; $5 monthly service fee unless waived (waived for primary owner age 13-24).
Bonus deposited within 30 days of meeting requirements; account must stay open; bonus reported as income to tax authorities.
Cannot be combined with any other consumer deposit offer; limit one bonus per customer/account.
Account may be closed and bonus reversed if bonus abuse is suspected.

steps: Open a new Wells Fargo Clear Access Banking account from the offer webpage, using the bonus offer code (or open at a branch with $25 minimum deposit).

Within 60 calendar days of account opening, make 10 or more qualifying posted transactions (posted Zelle transfers, bill pay, debit card purchases, mobile check deposits — not ATM/teller or pending transactions).
The $125 bonus is deposited into the new account within 30 days of meeting the requirements; keep the account open until payout.
